title: Altimeter, Atreides urge Nvidia board to keep doors open for Jensen Huang's return as CEO
summary: In a letter addressed to the company's board, Altimeter CEO Brad Gerstner and Atreides Managing Partner and Chief Investment Officer Gavin Baker said the board should not rush to appoint a permanent successor before all the facts surrounding Huang's departure are known.
llm_summary: Altimeter’s CEO Brad Gerstner and Atreides partner Gavin Baker wrote to Nvidia’s board urging it to keep the door open for founder‑CEO Jensen Huang rather than rush to name a permanent replacement before the circumstances of his exit are fully clarified. They argue that preserving continuity could be crucial for the company’s momentum and reassure investors that the board is acting prudently.
